response.justification: The candidate is a skilled senior software engineer with a broad range of experience, but he is a poor fit for this specific role. His C++ experience is minimal, not recent, and falls far short of the 5-10 years required on the Windows platform. Furthermore, his professional background lacks the required domain expertise in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, or Fixed Income. His recent work has been focused on technologies like TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, which do not align with the core requirements of this position.
strengths: Broad technical expertise as a polyglot developer across web, mobile, and desktop.
Strong background in modern software practices including CI/CD, TDD, and DevOps.
Excellent communication and knowledge-sharing skills, evidenced by public speaking and workshops.
concerns: Lacks the required 5-10 years of strong, hands-on C++ experience; the last relevant role was in 2015.
No demonstrated experience in the mandatory financial domains (Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Fixed Income).
Experience is primarily with web technologies and Linux, not the required C++ on Windows stack.
